title: 24-hour config setting in the widget (not systemwide) does not propagate to items in the "Copy to clipboard" menu
line: The Digital Clock's Copy to Clipboard menu now shows times in the 12 or 24-hour format chosen in the widget's settings.
explanation: The clock's own label builds its time format from the widget's Time display setting (timeFormatCorrection() in DigitalClock.qml), but the Copy to Clipboard menu (ClipboardMenu in the C++ plugin) used the locale's short and long time formats unchanged and never knew about the setting. On a 12-hour locale with the widget set to 24-hour, the menu therefore offered '2:54 AM' while the panel showed 02:54. The widget now hands the menu the same timeFormat and timeFormatWithSeconds the label uses, so both always agree; the long variant appends the time zone name as before, and the menu converts the time to the widget's selected time zone instead of only relabelling the local time.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: Follow the 12/24-hour setting in Copy to Clipboard

The Copy to Clipboard menu used the locale's time formats as they are,
so it offered AM/PM times while the clock was set to 24-hour time. Give
the menu the clock's own time formats, and convert to the clock's zone.

BUG: 452888

media.caption: Clock set to 24-hour shows 02:54, but every time in Copy to Clipboard has AM/PM (master, en_US)
With the fix the menu lists 02:59, 02:59:00 Central European Standard Time and 24-hour date-times, matching the panel
